findings.finding: Positive inbound recv refreshes server rdata_tick; non-server inactivity >60 seconds sets EOF. 20-second pacing is justified for this pinned 60-second configuration, not arbitrary deployment configuration.

Parent read-only deployed configuration evidence records stall_time=60, zero extra imports and deployed config SHA a90ca0f9edcf0504e2e3bbba4828f3664839527df1a4c10eb0090e16ad42f122. This is not the pinned public whole-file SHA; independent reviewer did not access live services.

Actual ScheduledAgent.tick reaches native drain after strict state projection and before native-event/timer cognition and script execution. Independent repeated idle ticks confirm keepalive precedes script step. Operator command dispatch happens earlier; no universal claim about all work preceding the pump.

Exact-True running/map/reader plus live socket, no receive/dispatch errors, contiguous frames, received position and valid vitals/progression gate sends. Getters remain send-free. Same-clock calls and missed intervals do not burst.

Timers are per client and reset on native epochs and explicit connect/close boundaries, not ordinary same-epoch map receipts. Wire connect owns prior-transport close. Send poison blocks state/readiness before epoch reset and clears only after successful lifecycle completion or successful send.

Finite/non-reversed clock checks deny invalid numerical clock values; malformed nonnumeric clock values raise TypeError before sending, without guessed timestamps. Callback control-flow exception origin propagates unchanged.

Poison is set before fallible send. ConnectionError and KeyboardInterrupt exact objects and deepest send frame survive; no automatic retry. Failed close/connect retain poison and exact lifecycle origin, successful close clears poison while offline readiness still denies sends.
Existing wire keepalive sends six-byte 0x0360; reply 0x007F remains fixed six bytes. No encoding/packet-table changes were made by review.
